## Story

**As a** consultant, **I want** to signal "I'm ready" on a goal, **so that** my coach knows to validate me.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] "Mark Ready" on goal card → sets `ReadyAt`, status → PendingReview
- [ ] Button disabled until coach reviews (spam prevention)
